g.text: 400 equations. A claim you can carry.
Captured FiPy final transient · verified without its solver
All 400 candidate components; no smoothing or exclusions.
Bounds are subpixel here. Exact fractions are authoritative.

g.text: A valid enclosure and a useful threshold are different outcomes.
Steady controls: altered answer → certified, threshold undecidable. Unit weights → proof premise fails.
Stored binary64 equations only; not physical accuracy.
FiPy / NIST source and terms retained · exact JSON and checker included
